title: PHE Handwara warns employees of action over drinking water disruptions

ai.summary: The Jal Shakti (PHE) Division Handwara issued a circular warning field staff over drinking water disruptions, demanding prompt action on complaints and road blockades to address supply issues.

facts.claim: frequent complaints about disruption in drinking water supply
facts.quote: Taking serious note of frequent complaints about disruption in drinking water supply and alleged negligence by field staff

facts.claim: complaints about interruptions in water supply continued to pour in
facts.quote: complaints about interruptions in water supply continued to pour in despite repeated directions to the concerned officials

facts.claim: failure to address public grievances had forced people to block roads in protest
facts.quote: failure to address public grievances had, at times, forced people to block roads in protest

facts.claim: directed Assistant Executive Engineers, Assistant Engineers and Junior Engineers to ensure adequate deployment of manpower
facts.quote: The department has directed Assistant Executive Engineers, Assistant Engineers and Junior Engineers to ensure adequate deployment of manpower in their respective jurisdictions

facts.claim: issue public advisories on judicious use of water
facts.quote: Officials have also been asked to issue public advisories on judicious use of water

facts.claim: remain available on phones round the clock
facts.quote: They have further been directed to remain available on their phones round the clock

facts.claim: warning of consequences for non-compliance including suspension, withholding of annual increments and imposition of fines
facts.quote: Action against defaulting officials may include suspension, withholding of annual increments and imposition of fines
